description: An elevated split squat placing high unilateral demand on front quadriceps, glutes, and pelvic stabilizers.
setup: Stand roughly two feet in front of a chair or bench, resting the top of your rear foot laces-down on the bench surface.
steps: Position lead foot flat on floor and torso inclined slightly forward.
Lower your back knee vertically toward the floor until front thigh reaches parallel.
Press firmly through lead heel and midfoot to return to top standing position.
cues: Drop back knee straight down rather than lunging forward
Keep front knee tracking over middle toes

mistakes.mistake: Placing lead foot too close to the bench causing heel lift
mistakes.fix: Hop front foot further forward to maintain flat front foot and comfortable knee angle

mistakes.mistake: Arching lower back excessively when descending
mistakes.fix: Tuck pelvis slightly and brace abs to keep spine neutral

rep_standard: Front thigh reaches parallel to the floor, full extension of front leg at top
